 lululemon's Black Friday sale is finally here — 20 best deals on belt bags, leggings, winter jackets and more
 Shop rare deals on men's and women's lululemon apparel, accessories and bags. 
 Kayla Kuefler Thu, November 19, 2026 at 3:32 a.m. UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Best deals from lululemon's 2026 Black Friday sale. Having covered every Black Friday since 2020, I have written about dozens, if not hundreds, of Black Friday sales . Every year, hundreds of phenomenal Black Friday sales hit Canada, but few are as good — or as popular — as lululemon's Black Friday sale .
 Lululemon's 2026 Black Friday sale is one of the absolute best times of the year to save on everything and anything lululemon, especially ahead of the holiday season . Many of the brand's bestsellers are featured in the sale, including lululemon's iconic belt bags and backpacks, men's and women's athletic pants, winter jackets and layers. Lululemon products rarely go on sale, so this is an especially good time to stock up on bags, leggings and more. Bonus? The lululemon Black Friday deals are up to 40 per cent off.
 Below, I've listed 20 lululemon Black Friday deals with discounts you can rarely find throughout the year. There's the iconic Everywhere Belt Bag for under $30 , a Dual Pouch Wristlet ( a fabulous gift idea! ) on sale for $24 and a "surprisingly warm" women's jacket for 40 per cent off, among many, many others. Trust us, lululemon's Black Friday deals sell out quickly, so if you have your eye on something, we recommend adding it to your cart.
